successors.name: Sosso Empire
successors.text: Wagadu and Koumbi Saleh: 'By 1203, the Sosso had risen against their masters and conquered Ghana.

ledger.x: 793: Wagadu, the Ghana empire of the Soninke, appears in the Sahel around Koumbi Saleh.
990: Ghana conquers Awdaghust and installs its own governor.
1201: Ghana ends as an independent empire.

wars.name: Ghana's conquest of Awdaghust
wars.outcome: Ghana took Awdaghust and installed its own governor.

wars.name: Almoravid capture of Awdaghust
wars.outcome: Awdaghust passed from Ghana to the Almoravids.

wars.name: Almoravid conquest of Ghana (disputed)
wars.outcome: Disputed: a tradition has the Almoravids conquering Ghana in 1076-77; Conrad and Fisher call this folklore and Lange agrees there was no conquest; Ghana converted to Islam around 1076.

wars.name: Sosso conquest of Ghana
wars.outcome: The Sosso took Koumbi Saleh and Wagadu; Diara Kante founded the Diarisso dynasty there and his son Soumaoro Kante exacted tribute.

certainty.note: Wagadu's frontiers are not described by any page opened: the Sahel and the tribute sphere are approximate.
